No file reads: line numbers, callers, callees and exact call sites, packed to a token budget. 2-4x the file coverage of BM25 and TF-IDF on SWE-Explore, and tops the paper's own sub-1B code model on CORE-Bench.

repositories.description: An enterprise-grade Smart CCTV system that combines real-time Computer Vision (YOLOv8) for threat detection with a Generative AI RAG Chatbot (Llama 3.2 + ChromaDB) to allow users to query security logs in natural language
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款企业级智能闭路电视系统，将用于威胁检测的实时计算机视觉（YOLOv8）与生成式人工智能 RAG 聊天机器人（Llama 3.2 + ChromaDB）相结合，使用户能够使用自然语言查询安全日志

repositories.description: Multimodal Generative AI Advertisement Generator using FLAN-T5, Whisper, LoRA and local media generation.
repositories.descriptionZh: 基于FLAN-T5、Whisper、LoRA和局部媒体生成的多模态生成式AI广告生成器。

repositories.description: AIdoc is a multimodal AI-powered clinical decision support platform designed to bring multiple types of patient information into a single clinical workspace. The project combines patient registry management, tabular machine-learning predictions, ECG biosignal analysis, medical imaging, and generative AI to help organize and interpret clinical data.
repositories.descriptionZh: AIdoc 是一个基于人工智能的多模态临床决策支持平台，旨在将多种类型的患者信息整合到单一的临床工作空间中。该项目融合了患者登记管理、表格化机器学习预测、心电图生物信号分析、医学影像以及生成式人工智能，以帮助整理和解读临床数据。

repositories.description: AI Engineering Portfolio | Building intelligent applications with Generative AI, Machine Learning, RAG, and Multimodal AI.
repositories.descriptionZh: AI 工程作品集 | 利用生成式 AI、机器学习、RAG 和多模态 AI 构建智能应用。

repositories.description: n8n pipeline that turns still images into AI-generated talking video reels, in unattended batches
repositories.descriptionZh: 一个 n8n 管道，可将静态图像转换为 AI 生成的会说话的短视频片段，且支持无人值守的批量处理

repositories.description: A multimodal AI vision application that lets users analyze, compare, search, and interact with multiple images using Gemini and Streamlit.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款多模态人工智能视觉应用程序，允许用户利用 Gemini 和 Streamlit 对多张图像进行分析、比较、搜索和交互。

repositories.description: This Generative AI Project proposes an intelligent financial data analyst that can process multimodal financial documents, retrieve relevant evidence, perform numerical and statistical analysis using external tools, and generate grounded analytical responses with supporting evidence.
repositories.descriptionZh: 该生成式人工智能项目提出了一种智能金融数据分析师，它能够处理多模态金融文档，检索相关证据，利用外部工具进行数值和统计分析，并生成基于事实且附有支持证据的分析性答复。

repositories.description: A multimodal RAG research assistant that lets users upload PDF, TXT, and image files, ask questions in natural language, and receive evidence-grounded answers with source attribution.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款多模态RAG研究助手，允许用户上传PDF、TXT和图像文件，以自然语言提出问题，并获得附有来源标注的、基于证据的答案。

repositories.description: Multimodal GenAI proof of concept: turns a customer voice note or screenshot into a structured lead (Whisper + GPT-4o + Pydantic) and replies with text-to-speech. Built in Python with the OpenAI API.
repositories.descriptionZh: 多模态生成式人工智能（GenAI）概念验证：将客户的语音备忘录或截图转换为结构化潜在客户信息（Whisper + GPT-4o + Pydantic），并通过文本转语音功能进行回复。使用 Python 结合 OpenAI API 构建。

repositories.description: Multimodal enterprise knowledge agent: AI RAG over docs, tables, PDFs and images with hybrid retrieval, document-level ACLs, prompt-injection guard and grounded, cited LLM answers.
repositories.descriptionZh: 多模态企业知识代理：基于文档、表格、PDF 和图像的 AI RAG，具备混合检索、文档级访问控制列表 (ACL)、提示注入防护机制，以及基于事实且附有引用来源的 LLM 回答。

repositories.description: Multimodal AI-powered marketing content generator using LLMs, Deep Learning, LangChain, and generative AI for text, image, audio & video.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款基于多模态、由人工智能驱动的营销内容生成器，利用大型语言模型（LLMs）、深度学习、LangChain 以及生成式人工智能来生成文本、图像、音频和视频内容。

repositories.description: Real-time Generative AI customer service bot using Google Gemini, RAG, multimodal document analysis, support tickets, security, and monitoring.
repositories.descriptionZh: 基于 Google Gemini、RAG、多模态文档分析、支持工单、安全及监控功能的实时生成式人工智能客服机器人。

repositories.description: Multimodal computer vision with Hugging Face: image captioning and VQA with BLIP, text-to-image with Stable Diffusion 1.5 and SDXL Turbo, plus prompt, guidance and step experiments.
repositories.descriptionZh: 使用 Hugging Face 进行多模态计算机视觉：基于 BLIP 的图像描述和视觉问答（VQA），基于 Stable Diffusion 1.5 和 SDXL Turbo 的文本到图像生成，以及提示词、指导和分步实验。

repositories.description: Multimodal Generative AI Assistant built with Python, Streamlit, Google Cloud Vertex AI, Gemini, Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款基于 Python、Streamlit、Google Cloud Vertex AI、Gemini、语音转文本和文本转语音技术构建的多模态生成式 AI 助手。

repositories.description: Cloud-native multimodal Generative AI chatbot built with Python, Streamlit, Amazon Bedrock, Groq and Amazon Cognito. Deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an internal Application Load Balancer and CloudFront, with Docker, Amazon ECR, IAM security, CloudWatch observability and GitHub Actions CI/CD.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款基于 Python、Streamlit、Amazon Bedrock、Groq 和 Amazon Cognito 构建的云原生多模态生成式 AI 聊天机器人。部署在 AWS ECS Fargate 上，位于内部应用程序负载均衡器和 CloudFront 之后，采用 Docker、Amazon ECR、IAM 安全机制、CloudWatch 可观测性以及 GitHub Actions CI/CD。

repositories.description: Generative AI Multimodal OCR & Document Chatbot Studio built with ASP.NET Core 8 Web API + React + TypeScript + Google Gemini 3.8
repositories.descriptionZh: 基于 ASP.NET Core 8 Web API + React + TypeScript + Google Gemini 3.8 构建的生成式 AI 多模态 OCR 与文档聊天机器人工作室

repositories.description: LIBA AgentForge Day 1 Checkpoint 3: reviewed multimodal evidence, memory and channels
repositories.descriptionZh: LIBA AgentForge 第一天 第3个检查点：回顾了多模态证据、记忆和通道

repositories.description: AI film production agent and The Seeder, a three-person course project portfolio
repositories.descriptionZh: AI电影制作代理与《The Seeder》——一项三人课程项目作品集

repositories.description: Assistive Multimodal Generative AI framework converting spoken vocabulary (English/Kannada) into 8-scene synthetic video demonstrations with synchronized auditory focus loops for specially abled learners.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款辅助性多模态生成式人工智能框架，可将语音词汇（英语/卡纳达语）转换为包含8个场景的合成视频演示，并配有同步的听觉焦点循环，专为残障学习者设计。

repositories.description: スマートフォンからローカルAI・画像・動画・音声を利用するHostとWeb UI
Multimodal AI learning platform for evidence-grounded, collaborative knowledge reconstruction.
repositories.descriptionZh: 用于基于证据的协作式知识重建的多模态人工智能学习平台。

repositories.description: Multimodal visual-to-schema and UI component reverse-engineering engine powered by Google's @google/genai SDK and Gemini 2.5 Flash.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款基于 Google 的 @google/genai SDK 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash 驱动的多模态视觉到模式及 UI 组件逆向工程引擎。

repositories.description: A persistent multimodal AI memory system powered by hybrid retrieval, reranking, and an agentic workflow.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一种基于混合检索、重新排序和代理式工作流的持久型多模态人工智能记忆系统。

repositories.description: RAG and Agentic AI-based multimodal assistance system for product troubleshooting and maintenance.
repositories.descriptionZh: 基于RAG和Agentic AI的产品故障排查与维护多模态辅助系统。

repositories.description: Hands on practice and projects from the CodingWise Generative AI & LLM Engineering course. Covers LLM fundamentals, OpenAI API, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines with LangChain, Hugging Face, fine tuning, and multimodal AI.
repositories.descriptionZh: 来自 CodingWise“生成式 AI 与 LLM 工程”课程的实践操作和项目。内容涵盖 LLM 基础知识、OpenAI API、提示词工程、基于 LangChain 的 RAG 管道、Hugging Face、微调以及多模态 AI。

repositories.description: A multimodal RAG application for document Q&A using hybrid retrieval, reranking, and LLM-powered responses with source citations.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款基于多模态RAG的文档问答应用，该应用结合了混合检索、重新排序以及由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动并附有来源引用的回答。

repositories.description: Multimodal AI pipeline built for Women Tech Quest (WTQ) Hackathon by 10Pearls to extract structured billing data and answer complex customer queries from utility bills using Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite.
repositories.descriptionZh: 由 10Pearls 为 Women Tech Quest（WTQ）黑客马拉松构建的多模态 AI 管道，利用 Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite 从公用事业账单中提取结构化计费数据，并回答复杂的客户查询。

repositories.description: AI-powered waste segregation and sustainability assistant using multimodal Gemini AI for responsible waste management.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款基于AI的垃圾分类与可持续发展助手，采用多模态Gemini AI技术，助力实现负责任的垃圾管理。

repositories.description: Arabic-first personal finance assistant combining GenAI, deterministic financial analytics, agentic workflows, multimodal input, and AWS/Twilio deployment.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款以阿拉伯语为主的个人理财助手，融合了生成式人工智能（GenAI）、确定性财务分析、代理式工作流、多模态输入以及基于AWS/Twilio的部署。

repositories.description: AI creative production workspace with structured LLM generation, multimodal assets, human review workflows, version history, and usage tracking.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款集结构化大型语言模型（LLM）生成、多模态素材、人工审核工作流、版本历史记录及使用情况追踪于一体的AI创意制作工作空间。

repositories.description: A 5-project progression from foundational RAG to production-oriented Agentic AI systems, covering autonomous agents, multimodal RAG, corrective RAG, and real-time AI.
repositories.descriptionZh: 从基础 RAG 到面向生产应用的代理式 AI 系统，共包含 5 个项目，涵盖自主代理、多模态 RAG、修正型 RAG 以及实时 AI。

repositories.description: Enterprise-grade multimodal AI video generation pipeline orchestrating Google Gemini 3.5, Imagen 3 & Veo 3.1 with fault-tolerant state recovery, dynamic captioning, and cloud observability.
repositories.descriptionZh: 企业级多模态 AI 视频生成管道，整合了 Google Gemini 3.5、Imagen 3 和 Veo 3.1，具备容错状态恢复、动态字幕生成和云可观测性功能。

repositories.description: Turns a flat-pack furniture manual (PDF) into a captioned 3D assembly video: multimodal LLMs, an assembly graph, a general 3D layout engine and Blender. Live demo inside.
repositories.descriptionZh: 将平板包装家具说明书（PDF）转化为带字幕的3D组装视频：多模态大型语言模型、组装图、通用3D布局引擎和Blender。内含实时演示。

repositories.description: AI farming assistant for India's small farmers: crop plan from soil + weather, best mandi after transport, multimodal Crop Doctor, grounded RAG assistant with guardrails — measured in public.
repositories.descriptionZh: 面向印度小农户的AI农业助手：基于土壤和天气制定的种植方案，考虑运输成本后的最佳农贸市场，多模态“作物医生”，配备安全防护机制的、脚踏实地的RAG助手——所有功能均在公开环境中经过验证。

repositories.description: Morteza Mellati is a researcher in technology-enhanced education and applied linguistics, with a particular focus on generative AI, multimodal learning, educational assessment, and feedback. His research examines how AI and emerging technologies transform learning processes, assessment practices, feedback literacy, and learning development.
repositories.descriptionZh: 莫尔特扎·梅拉蒂（Morteza Mellati）是技术增强教育与应用语言学领域的研究人员，其研究重点特别集中在生成式人工智能、多模态学习、教育评估和反馈方面。他的研究探讨了人工智能和新兴技术如何改变学习过程、评估实践、反馈素养以及学习发展。

repositories.description: 🪢 Open source agent evals & observability: Trace, evaluate, and improve LLM applications with one open platform.
repositories.descriptionZh: 🪢 开源代理评估与可观测性：借助一个开源平台，对大型语言模型（LLM）应用进行追踪、评估和优化。

repositories.description: The open source AI engineering platform for agents, LLMs, and ML models. MLflow enables teams of all sizes to debug, evaluate, monitor, and optimize production-quality AI applications while controlling costs and managing access to models and data.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一个面向智能体、大型语言模型（LLMs）和机器学习模型的开源人工智能工程平台。MLflow 使各种规模的团队都能对生产级人工智能应用进行调试、评估、监控和优化，同时控制成本并管理对模型和数据的访问权限。

repositories.description: AI Observability & Evaluation
repositories.descriptionZh: AI 可观测性与评估

repositories.description: Evidently is ​​an open-source ML and LLM observability framework. Evaluate, test, and monitor any AI-powered system or data pipeline. From tabular data to Gen AI. 100+ metrics.
repositories.descriptionZh: Evidently 是一个开源的机器学习和大型语言模型可观测性框架。可用于评估、测试和监控任何基于人工智能的系统或数据管道。从表格数据到生成式人工智能，支持 100 多项指标。

repositories.description: Ship AI Agents to Google Cloud in minutes, not months. Production-ready templates with built-in CI/CD, evaluation, and observability.
repositories.descriptionZh: 只需几分钟（而非数月）即可将 AI 代理部署到 Google Cloud。这些模板已准备好投入生产环境，并集成了 CI/CD、评估和可观测性功能。

repositories.description: 🧊 Open source LLM observability platform. One line of code to monitor, evaluate, and experiment. YC W23 🍓
repositories.descriptionZh: 🧊 开源大语言模型可观测性平台。只需一行代码即可进行监控、评估和实验。YC W23 🍓

repositories.description: Next-generation AI Agent Optimization Platform: Cozeloop addresses challenges in AI agent development by providing full-lifecycle management capabilities from development, debugging, and evaluation to monitoring.
